Only 7.2 points of difference in Elo rating stands between Fabiano Caruana and Magnus Carlsen. After 15 years of Magnus being the undisputed World no.1 (Since July 2011), is a change in the rankings coming? In this video, we show you the moments of Fabiano Caruana's win, Haik drawing Game 2 against Magnus Carlsen at the Total Chess World Championship, and much more.
Video: ChessBase India
Shot by: Abhyudaya Ram, Himank Ghosh
Edited by: Himank Ghosh
